title: Server Activity and more Statistics links
summary: Check Jellyfin's tasks and recent activity, and open more Statistics figures in History.
highlights: Server Activity shows server details, running maintenance tasks and recent results, with filters for date, event type, severity and user or system events.
Server Activity is read-only and shows up to 1,000 loaded events. With Jellydash login enabled, it is available to owners and admins.
Open watch-time totals and day, month or year bars in History for the corresponding period.
Source video codec and transcoding reason links keep their scope through History filters, pagination and CSV export.
